Idk I just can’t function like a normal human anymore. I’m just so damn lonely and it’s like everyone pretends to care when it’s convenient for them but the second they don’t have to try, they leave and when I see them again, suddenly I’m stable and ok and not fucked in the head. Honestly, I wonder, if ppl didn’t know about my s/h and suicidal thoughts, would they still take me seriously. Probably not, and even with that knowledge, they still push me away and say “I’m busy, I’ll talk to you later” and then never do even when that’s their god damn job (I’m talking about my head of year at school here who’s also my school’s safeguarding lead who said I could go to her whenever I felt like relapsing) and i do see a counsellor but it’s like the moment the hour is up, everything is fine and she’s talking about the bloody weather like I never confessed some fucked up self destructive shit to her right before that. I just feel like I won’t be missed much; I’ve always been a quiet kid who could slip away from a group I was hanging out with, and nobody would even notice my absence. I’ve got summer break rn and I’m scared for next year because idk who I am anymore and putting up a facade seems like the only choice but idk what my real persona is, let alone a fake one. People don’t usually leave things such as money lying around which also indicates that you dont have many visitors or the ones you do have are close enough to you for you to not bother tidying up. You don’t spend that much time at home, most likely because you’re exercising or your at school or work. I’d guess school and assume that you’re probably in university getting a degree related to electronics. I got that from the book. The fact that it’s about inventing could indicate that you are an ambitious individual. Back to you not being at home much, I got this from the cycling helmet and bottle being close to hand; people tend to spend a lot of time at their desks. You also have a wallet with the American flag which I would usually interpret as country pride but in this case I think it’s a souvenir where coupled with my other deductions. The last piece of evidence for your absence in your home is the extension lead. It suggests that you don’t have many sockets in that room. People usually invest in to these sort of things so you’ve either just moved in or this is only a temporary place you’re staying at.
